firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently watched the Thunderbirds TV show starts.
clarifications: Give that player the dice. Players take turns clockwise, each with an Action Phase followed by a Disaster Phase.

internalEvidence: Rendered page 3 gives the TV-viewing criterion and dice handoff; page 5 gives the clockwise turn sequence. The Tracy characters, Thunderbirds machines, Hood Track and cooperative setup match inventory BGG 160610. Modiphius identifies itself as publisher of Matt Leacock’s Thunderbirds game.
